issues.message: /controller/outputs/io_6: Invalid conditional expression 'if stage == 2 then score else (if prepDone then score else 0)'. if condition then value else value is not the executable SysML expression syntax. Return {"if":"condition","then":"yesValue","else":"noValue"}; this renders (if condition ? yesValue else noValue). Example: if remaining > 0 then remaining - delta else 0 becomes {"if":"remaining > 0","then":"remaining - delta","else":0}. For a conditional nested in arithmetic, return the WHOLE expression as nested objects: elapsed + (if enabled then delta else 0) becomes {"+":["elapsed",{"if":"enabled","then":"delta","else":0}]}. Never put a JSON object inside an expression string. Preserve both values and the original condition; then/else action arrays are different from expression values.
